commandRunner.command: pnpm exec vitest run --coverage.enabled=false --bail=1 test/views/dates/logic test/state
commandRunner.$comment: Revision 50 (WP19 Task 19.4): the web's pure-logic files, run over their pure unit tests only (test/views/dates/logic and test/state, every one a .test.ts), never the jsdom component tests. StringLiteral mutants are left out for the reason apps/api gives: the words are the catalogue's, pinned phrase by phrase in those tests and swept for banned words, and a mutant that changes a word the tests do not quote proves nothing about a rule. Every condition, threshold, branch and arithmetic mutant is kept.
